products.quality: Built-in Material Test generator: Param dropdown (Power/Speed/Interval/Passes/Frequency/Q-Pulse), Count grid (default 10x10), Min/Max ranges, separate material/text/border cut settings, preset export/import. Roster's most flexible grid generator and the reference.

CNC-only (no laser); material power×speed grids are a laser feature. MillMage's Operation Settings Editor lists only CNC ops (Pocket/Profile/Drill/Surfacing/Face/Bore/etc.); no material-test or feeds/speeds grid generator.

evidence.cite: INF: absence inferred from MillMage's CNC-only feature set (Phase-0 coverage note; docs list no material-test tool).

products.quality: No built-in grid generator. Testing is done by importing fixed downloadable test files (lasergrbl.com test-file page) or generating grids in LightBurn/online tools; LaserGRBL only runs an imported file.

Material Test Array (Array > Material Test Array): Power=X columns, Speed=Y rows; adjustable min/max, row/column count, spacing, editable header labels; supports vector+bitmap. Solid but two-axis only (power×speed), fewer axes than LightBurn.

CNC; no material power×speed grid generator. Provides Inventables-tested default feeds/speeds per bit+material and a feeds/speeds calculator; its downloadable 'calibration test pattern' checks machine mechanics (lost steps, perpendicularity), not material settings.

evidence.cite: INF: no material-test grid generator found in Easel docs; inferred absent (feeds/speeds is a calculator, not a test-grid generator).

products.quality: No built-in test grid generator; an official-forum feature request explicitly asks for a LightBurn-style N×M power/feed grid, and users script external Python to build grids. CNC design/CAM only.

Two dedicated Laser Tools generators: Interval Test (squares at varied Line Interval) and Focus Test (Z ramp — Start Z/End Z/Steps/Speed/Max Power; requires a motorized Z controllable in LightBurn). Roster-leading.
CNC-only; line-interval (raster) and focus-ramp tests are laser concepts with no MillMage equivalent. No such generator in the CNC toolpath/operation feature set.

evidence.cite: INF: interval/focus tests are laser-specific; inferred absent from MillMage's CNC-only scope (Phase-0 coverage note).

No line-interval-test or focus-ramp generator. Focus is handled by autofocus / automatic distance measurement and manual focal-ruler measurement (plus downloadable focus test files), not a generated ramp; no interval-test tool documented.

products.quality: Highly customizable: 'Enable Text' labels and 'Enable Border' toggles, per-axis Param choice (6 params), Min/Max/Count, rectangle Height/Width, absolute positioning, preset save/export/import (User Bundle). No explicit power safety cap beyond user Min/Max.
